parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human MCH receptor 1 (CHEMBL344). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_records on activities.record_id and docs on compound_records.doc_id. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce SMILES presence. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL344 and standard_type IC50. Require standard_relation = '=' and non-null standard_value. Require docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR docs.doi IS NOT NULL. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
